    FORM FOLLOWS REFLEX.

    Mass sits where the palm closes, not where the shell is widest. The balance point falls 4 mm behind the stick axis, so the product settles instead of tipping.

    Four material zones, one continuous surface: anodised wing, moulded grip, soft-touch flank, glass panel.
